note: Which newspaper served which town, and a link to it. The English path only: their robots.txt disallows the other eleven language paths and those are left alone. The year span each paper covers is NOT here — it lives on the paper's own 110 KB page, and thousands of fetches for a date range is not a polite trade for a catalogue. Town and paper names are title-cased slugs, not the papers' own spelling; «labske-proudy» cannot give back «Labské Proudy», so the slug is kept beside it.
